test_nested_modules: test that pybind11 nested modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test pybind11 classes with internal references and verify ConstructorStats tracking of alive objects
test_importing: test that a Python type like OrderedDict can be imported and re-exported from a pybind11 module
test_pydoc: test that pydoc can generate documentation for pybind11 modules and their contents
test_duplicate_registration: test that registering two items with the same name in a pybind11 module returns an empty list
